// ==========================================================================
// THE COLA SET'S PLACEMENT PAGES -- where each gun sits in your hand.
//
// GENERATED by _pending/tools/make_menudef.py from WMCARD.cola, alongside that set's
// CVARINFO. Both come off the same card and the same stem rule, so a slider cannot name
// a cvar that does not exist. DO NOT EDIT -- change the card and run it again.
//
// EVERY SLIDER HERE MOVES THE GUN WHILE THE MENU IS OPEN. These are renderer-read cvars;
// a menu freezes the playsim, so a slider on a script-read cvar would move nothing at the
// one moment it is wanted. That is what the LINT-LIVE lines declare and what menu_lint
// checks.
// ==========================================================================

// LINT-LIVE: WM_Place_Cola
OptionMenu "WM_Place_Cola"
{
	Title "COLA -- WHERE EACH GUN SITS"
	StaticText "Pick a gun, then drag. It moves in your hand as you drag it.", 1
	StaticText "Put the gun in your hand first -- you are adjusting what you can see.", "DarkGray"
	StaticText ""
	Submenu "CL_CardDeck", "WM_Place_Cola_cl_carddeck"
	Submenu "CL_FryPan", "WM_Place_Cola_cl_frypan"
	Submenu "CL_Jackhammer", "WM_Place_Cola_cl_jackhammer"
	Submenu "CL_ParticleGun", "WM_Place_Cola_cl_particlegun"
	Submenu "CL_PlasmaGun", "WM_Place_Cola_cl_plasmagun"
	Submenu "CL_Revolver", "WM_Place_Cola_cl_revolver"
	Submenu "CL_KS23", "WM_Place_Cola_cl_ks23"
	Submenu "CL_Sidewinder", "WM_Place_Cola_cl_sidewinder"
}

AddOptionMenu "OptionsMenu"
{
	Submenu "VR Weapons -- Cola: where each gun sits", "WM_Place_Cola"
}

// LINT-LIVE: WM_Place_Cola_cl_carddeck
OptionMenu "WM_Place_Cola_cl_carddeck"
{
	Title "CL_CARDDECK"
	StaticText "WHERE IT SITS ON YOUR CONTROLLER -- MOVES LIVE", "Gold"
	Slider "Left / right",   "cl_carddeck_ofs_x", -100.0, 100.0, 0.25, 2
	Slider "Forward / back", "cl_carddeck_ofs_y", -100.0, 100.0, 0.25, 2
	Slider "Down / up",      "cl_carddeck_ofs_z", -100.0, 100.0, 0.25, 2
	SafeCommand "Reset where it sits", "resetcvar cl_carddeck_ofs_x; resetcvar cl_carddeck_ofs_y; resetcvar cl_carddeck_ofs_z"
	StaticText ""
	StaticText "HOW IT IS TURNED -- MOVES LIVE", "Gold"
	Slider "Yaw",   "cl_carddeck_yaw",   -180, 180, 1, 0
	Slider "Pitch", "cl_carddeck_pitch", -180, 180, 1, 0
	Slider "Roll",  "cl_carddeck_roll",  -180, 180, 1, 0
	StaticText "Roll is the one that fixes a gun rotated like a cylinder.", "DarkGray"
	SafeCommand "Reset how it is turned", "resetcvar cl_carddeck_yaw; resetcvar cl_carddeck_pitch; resetcvar cl_carddeck_roll"
	StaticText ""
	StaticText "HOW BIG IT IS -- MOVES LIVE", "Gold"
	Slider "Size",         "cl_carddeck_scale",   0.05, 4.0, 0.01, 2
	Slider "Size along X", "cl_carddeck_scale_x", 0.05, 3.0, 0.01, 2
	Slider "Size along Y", "cl_carddeck_scale_y", 0.05, 3.0, 0.01, 2
	Slider "Size along Z", "cl_carddeck_scale_z", 0.05, 3.0, 0.01, 2
	StaticText "Above zero only -- the renderer ignores zero and below.", "DarkGray"
	SafeCommand "Reset its size", "resetcvar cl_carddeck_scale; resetcvar cl_carddeck_scale_x; resetcvar cl_carddeck_scale_y; resetcvar cl_carddeck_scale_z"
}
